 Africa Cup of Nations Qualification
 Live: Cameroon vs. Namibia | AFCON 2027 Qualifiers
 Cameroon and Namibia face off in a crucial match in the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifiers. The Indomitable Lions are determined to defend their lead in Group G, while the Brave Warriors are looking to pull off an upset and change the course of the qualification race.
 Don't miss the match between Cameroon and Namibia on beIN SPORTS. 
 Cameroon Aim to Make Home Advantage Count
 The Cameroon national team return home with an opportunity to take a major step toward the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations .
 The team coached by David Pagou enter the match at the top of Group G with four points from their opening two fixtures.
 The Indomitable Lions began their campaign with a 3-1 victory over Comoros , thanks to goals from David Roi Nyengue , Bryan Mbeumo , and Danny Namaso .
 They followed that result with a 1-1 draw against Congo , which allowed them to remain unbeaten but kept the battle for first place wide open.
 Now, playing in front of their supporters at Japoma Stadium in Douala, Cameroon need to rediscover their attacking efficiency to avoid unnecessary complications.
 Bryan Mbeumo and Danny Namaso are expected to be two of their main attacking threats, while the return of Enzo Ebosse provides additional defensive options.
 However, the head coach will have to deal with several important absences.
 Carlos Baleba was left out of the squad because of a muscle injury and was replaced by Ryan Fosso , while Christian Kofane will also be unavailable.
 Despite these setbacks, Cameroon will be expected to make the most of their home advantage and remain at the top of the standings.
 Namibia Look to Pull Off an Upset in Douala
 On the other side stands a Namibia team that still has plenty to fight for in these qualifiers.
 The Brave Warriors, coached by Collin Benjamin , began their campaign with a 1-0 victory over Congo , thanks to a headed goal from Bethuel Muzeu .
 However, they subsequently suffered a narrow defeat against Comoros , bringing their promising start to a halt.
 With three points, Namibia sit just one point behind Cameroon , meaning an away victory could completely transform the Group G standings.
 The team have experienced players such as Peter Shalulile , Deon Hotto , and Riaan Hanamub , who will be crucial in competing against one of Africa's traditional powerhouses.
 Collin Benjamin's main challenge will be finding the right balance between defensive organization and taking advantage of counterattacking opportunities.
 In addition, Namibia will be without Peter Shitembi , who has been ruled out through injury.
 For the Brave Warriors, securing a positive result in Douala would represent a massive boost to their qualification ambitions.
 Back-to-Back Clashes Could Decide Group G
 The match between Cameroon and Namibia carries special significance because it will be the first of two consecutive meetings during this international window.
 After their encounter in Douala, the two national teams will face each other again on Monday, November 16, with Namibia serving as the home team in a match scheduled to take place in Botswana.
 Cameroon currently lead Group G with four points, followed by Comoros and Namibia , who both have three. Congo sit at the bottom of the standings with one point.
 The top two teams will qualify for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations , which will be hosted by Kenya , Tanzania , and Uganda .
 With so little separating the teams, these two matches could prove decisive in determining the outcome of the qualification race.

 The third-round match in the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifiers will take place on Thursday, November 12, at Japoma Stadium in Douala.

 Key Takeaways From Cameroon vs. Namibia
 Cameroon lead Group G with four points and are looking to maintain their unbeaten record despite the absences of Carlos Baleba and Christian Kofane .
 Namibia have three points and will rely on players such as Peter Shalulile and Deon Hotto to secure a historic away result.
 The two national teams will meet again on November 16 in a doubleheader that could shape the qualification race for AFCON 2027 .
